description: This file appears to be part of a larger C project related to Git internals, particularly handling object graph traversal and reachability analysis. It defines functions and data structures for marking objects as reachable, adding recent objects, and managing progress during traversal.

classes.name: connectivity_progress
classes.description: Structure to keep track of progress during object graph traversal, including a progress indicator and count.

classes.name: recent_data
classes.description: Structure to hold data used when adding recent objects to traversal, including revision info, timestamp, callback, and object sets.

methods.name: void update_progress(struct connectivity_progress * cp)
methods.description: Updates the progress display by incrementing the count, displaying progress after every 1024 objects.

methods.name: void add_one_file(const char * path,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Reads a file path, retrieves its OID, and adds the corresponding object to the revision list if found.

methods.name: void add_rebase_files(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Marks objects recorded in rebase state files as reachable within the revision info.

methods.name: int add_one_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Adds an object pointed to by a reference to the revision's pending objects, handling dangling symbolic refs.

methods.name: void mark_object(struct object * obj UNUSED,const char * name UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Marks an object as seen and updates progress.

methods.name: void mark_commit(struct commit * c,void * data)
methods.description: Marks a commit object as seen.

methods.name: int run_one_gc_recent_objects_hook(struct oidset * set,const char * args)
methods.description: Runs an external hook to obtain additional recent objects, parsing their OIDs and inserting into a set.

methods.name: void load_gc_recent_objects(struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Loads additional recent objects defined by external hooks into the recent objects set.

methods.name: int obj_is_recent(const struct object_id * oid,timestamp_t mtime,struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Checks if an object is recent based on its modification time or inclusion in the recent objects set.

methods.name: void add_recent_object(const struct object_id * oid,struct packed_git * pack,off_t offset,timestamp_t mtime,struct recent_data * data)
methods.description: Adds a specific object to the revision list if it’s recent, determining its type and reading necessary data.

methods.name: int want_recent_object(struct recent_data * data,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Decides if a recent object should be included based on packing options.

methods.name: int add_recent_loose(const struct object_id * oid,const char * path,void * data)
methods.description: Handles adding loose recent objects to the revision list if they meet criteria.

methods.name: int add_recent_packed(const struct object_id * oid,struct packed_git * p,uint32_t pos,void * data)
methods.description: Handles adding packed recent objects to the revision list based on pack files.

methods.name: int add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal(struct rev_info * revs,timestamp_t timestamp,report_recent_object_fn * cb,int ignore_in_core_kept_packs)
methods.description: Main entry point to add recent objects to the traversal, including loose and packed objects.

methods.name: int mark_object_seen(const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,int exclude UNUSED,uint32_t name_hash UNUSED,struct packed_git * found_pack UNUSED,off_t found_offset UNUSED,void * payload UNUSED)
methods.description: Marks an object as seen in the object database.

methods.name: void mark_reachable_objects(struct rev_info * revs,int mark_reflog,timestamp_t mark_recent,struct progress * progress)
methods.description: Coordinates the process of marking all reachable objects, including refs, rebase files, reflogs, and recent objects, and reports progress.
